mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.5 percentage points in a single month signals aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate earnings growth prospects, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE increases > 0.2pp in 3 months) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In low-unemployment periods (UNRATE < 3.5%), SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC for UNRATE change in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust supply-side activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is above its 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a further rate increase (FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month) signals aggressive policy that increases borrowing costs and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS change in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
